Hon'ble Shri Arvind Kumar Verma, Judge Order on Board 28.07.2025
1.

This writ petition has been preferred under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking following reliefs:
"10.1.

That, the may kindly be quash/set-aside the impugned order no.735/ steno to SDM/A.VA.A./2025, Korba dated 15.04.2025 passed by the respondent no. 3 for forming of investigation team for investigating the operation of mid-day meal by the petitioner at Govt. Atmanand English school, Balco Nagar, Korba (C.G.), in the i n t e r e s t o f j u s t i c e . A n d t h e o r d e r d a t e d 2 2 . 0 7 . 2 0 2 5 O r d e r No.1798/A.VI.A/M.BHO/2025, Korba passed by respondent No.3 may kindly be set-aside by this Court.

10.2. That the Hon'ble court may kindly direct: the respondents to consider the representation filed by the petitioner and grant the petitioner the opportunity to be heard before passing any order against the operation of mid-day meal by the petitioner at at Govt. Atmanand English school, Balco Nagar, Korba (C.G.). and direct not to enact and take actions in pursuance of the order dated 15.04.2025, in the interest of justice.

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
10.3. Any other relief which deemed fit and proper may also be issued looking to the facts and circumstances of the case and looking to the interest of justice."
2.

Brief facts of this case are that the petitioner has filed this writ petition being aggrieved by the impugned order passed by the respondent no. 3 for the purpose of forming an investigation team against the petitioner's operation for mid-day meal at Swami Atmanand English Medium School,
Balco Nagar, Korba by anonymous complainant filed by the respondent no.7 & 8, which was moved with the motive to harass the petitioner and somehow bring hindrance in the operation of the mid-day meal provided by the petitioner at the said aforesaid school.

Swami Atmanand English Medium School,
Balco Nagar, Korba
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3. In the earlier round of litigation, vide order dated 25.03.2025 in WPC No.5424/2022, this Court has passed the following order/direction:
"Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, at this stage, prima facie, it appears that there is nothing against the petitioner and the petitioner is running the midday meal in accordance with law.
The petitioner society may continue the midday meal Programme.
However, if any complaint is made against the petitioner, the respondent authorities are at liberty to proceed in accordance with law.
7. With the aforesaid observations/directions, instant writ petition is disposed of"

sentences.text:
Thereafter, the petitioner has filed the writ petition (WPC No.3093/2025) before this Court,
which was disposed of on 18.07.2025, relevant portion of said order/direction reads as under:
"7. Considering above facts of the case, submissions of counsel for the parties, writ petition is disposed of at this stage permitting the petitioner to submit fresh representation before the concerned respondents- authorities within 15 days and in-turn concerned Authority shall conduct an enquiry regarding testing/verifying the quality of food supplied by the petitioner and also give proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and, thereafter, pass appropriate order on its own merit within 30 days from the date of receipt of copy of such representation.

8. The respondent-authority concerned is directed to permit/allow the petitioner-group to continue the work of preparation of Mid-Day-Meal in the concerned School till the inquiry is completed, however, petitioner-group is also directed to maintain the hygiene and quality of food as per standard of the food Safety."

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that impugned order dated 15.04.2025 is a non-speaking order as same has been passed only on the basis of enquiry report and without giving proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner.

He further contended that aforesaid order of this Court's dated 18.07.2025 was uploaded on the website on 22.07.2025 and on that day the petitioner has met with the District Education Officer and Sub Divisional Officer Korba and informed about the said order passed by this Court, but the respondent No.3 with malafide intention has passed the impugned order dated 22.07.2025 contrary to the relevant provision of law.

After knowing about the aforesaid order passed by this Court, the respondent-authority for the very purpose to frustrate the right of the petitioner and also frustrate the order of this Court and directed the private respondent no.6 to run the Mid-day meal program in the concerned School.

6. Learned State Counsel submits that based on complaint made with regard to quality of the food supplied by petitioner is not upto the mark, the Committee has been constituted to enquire the food quality supplied by the petitioner in the Swami Atmanand English Medium School.
The Inquiry Officer has made an enquiry and submitted the report vide Annexure P-3 before the concerned respondent-authority.

The Committee has found that there is poor quality of food supplied by the petitioner and, thereafter, respondent-authority has passed the impugned order and detached the petitioner from the work of preparation of Mid-Day-Meal in Swami Atmanand English School.

Learned State Counsel further contended that during the enquiry petitioner was not present on the spot, therefore, opportunity of hearing could not be given to him.
7.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the material/documents available on record including the impugned order.

8. It is pertinent to mention here that this Court has passed the order on 18.07.2025 in WPC No.3093/2025 on board, therefore, it is presume that respondent No.3/SDO is well aware about the order of this Court.

Considering above facts of the case, submissions of counsel for the parties, this Court is of the considered view that respondent No.3/SDO has committed error in passing the impugned order dated 22.07.2025 (Annexure P-1) and, therefore, impugned order dated 22.07.2025 (Annexure P-1)
is hereby set-aside.

However, petitioner is permitted to submit fresh representation before the concerned respondents- authorities within 15 days from today and in-turn concerned Authority shall conduct an enquiry regarding testing/verifying the quality of food supplied by the petitioner and also give proper opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and, thereafter, pass appropriate order on its own merit within 30 days from the date of receipt of copy of such representation.

10. The respondent-authority concerned is directed to permit/allow the petitioner-group to continue the work of preparation of Mid-Day-Meal in the concerned School till the inquiry is completed,
however, petitioner- group is also directed to maintain the hygiene and quality of food as per standard of the food Safety.
11.In the result, writ petition is allowed in part.
